translation: ⟨He who is partial⟩ ⟨to⟩ faces ⟨is⟩ not good, and ⟨the⟩ man will transgress for ⟨an⟩ ⟨את⟩ piece of bread

tokens.rationale: Hebrew הכר means to recognize or scrutinize; here idiomatically 'to show partiality' or 'discriminate'
Hebrew uses plural 'faces' (פנים) idiomatically for 'appearance' or 'person' in the context of showing favor
Hebrew לא is simple negation; English requires copula 'is'
Hebrew פת literally means 'a bit' or 'piece'; here idiomatically 'a piece of bread'; English article required
Hebrew פשע means 'to transgress' or 'rebel'; here the imperfect tense indicates future or habitual action
Hebrew גבר means 'man' or 'warrior'; English definite article required for sense
